title: Water-fuelled microwave electrothermal thruster flown by Momentus

tellings.quote: Oh, the uh I invented the water uh based microwave electrothermal thruster. Really? And using water as fuel, and I got it working, and now it's flown in space successfully.

plain: A rocket engine that runs on plain water, heated by microwaves to push a spacecraft, has flown successfully in space aboard a craft from the company Momentus, a small "space tug" that moves satellites around in orbit. The physicist John Brandenburg tells Michels he invented this water-based microwave thruster himself and got it working, which would mean water alone can serve as rocket fuel.
